summary: Maze Therapeutics filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an underwritten public offering of 5,540,000 shares of common stock and pre-funded warrants to purchase 850,000 shares. The offering price per share is $23.50, representing a ~8.5% discount to the last sale price of $25.69 on April 21, 2026. Total gross proceeds are approximately $150.2 million, with net proceeds to Maze of about $145.7 million after underwriting discounts. Leerink Partners is the sole underwriter. Delivery is expected on April 23, 2026. This is a routine capital raise via a shelf takedown, not a special situation. The filing involves no merger, acquisition, activist campaign, strategic review, or other transformative event. Note: No deal terms apply as this is a secondary offering, not a merger or tender.
